text: ポケモンに　どうぐを　つかうだけでも　こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ　さあ　こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　どうぐを　つかうだけでも
structure.en: even just using an item on a Pokémon

structure.jp: こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ
こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！
structure.en: this time it's the other side's turn!

patterns.name: 〜だけでも
patterns.explanation: だけ is 'just' and でも is 'even', so together after a verb they mean 'even by just doing it'. つかうだけでも = 'even just using it'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing happens completely, often when you'd rather it didn't. おわってしまう = 'ends up being over'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way to push your point, like 'I tell you'. ばんだぞ = 'it's their turn, you hear!'
